refill.why: Only one USE slot is needed, and U01 is clearer. '어쩌면 … 좋겠어' is a bit awkward, and the course's Korean wording for dylen ni is unconfirmed.
'그건' could be Welsh 'o' or 'hi', so the prompt has two possible answers.
'어쩌면 너 … 싶어?' is unnatural Korean. Putting efallai at the end of the question also isn't clear from the Korean.
'그게' could be Welsh 'o' or 'hi'. The Korean also blurs whether cyfri' means 'matter' or 'count'.
The Korean reorders words awkwardly, and '물어볼 거야' could be Welsh 'bydda i'n gofyn' or a different future form.
'피곤했어' doesn't show the pluperfect 'oedd … wedi blino' and could equally be 'roedden nhw wedi blino' or the simple past. '어쩌면 … 했어' also reads oddly.
